title: Customer Service Advisor
company: Solus Accident Repair Centres - Company - Permanent
description:
Overview
The Customer Consultant role at Solus is built around clear communication, organisation and a strong focus on customer experience. As a key point of contact, you support customers throughout their repair journey and help keep site operations running smoothly day to day.
This is a varied, hands-on role that combines customer service, coordination and the collection and delivery of customer vehicles, requiring good judgement, organisation and a professional approach.
As a Customer Consultant, you'll balance customer care with practical, site-based responsibilities.
Responsibilities
You'll:
- Keep customers updated on the progress of their vehicle repair
- Handle queries calmly and professionally, providing clear and timely responses
- Collect and deliver customer vehicles safely and courteously when required
- Arrange and coordinate vehicle movements and transport activity
- Support site operations, including parts coordination and basic administration
- Work closely with technicians, production teams and site leaders
- Help maintain a welcoming, organised and professional site environment

This is a role where reliability, attention to detail and empathy make a real difference to customer confidence.
Qualifications
We don't require formal qualifications for this role. What matters most is how you work with people, how you manage responsibility, and your willingness to be hands-on.
You'll bring:
- Strong customer service experience, ideally in a customer-facing role
- A full UK driving licence, with confidence driving customer vehicles
- Clear and professional communication skills, face-to-face and over the phone
- A calm and organised approach, even when managing multiple tasks
- Pride in representing the business when interacting with customers
- A positive, team-focused attitude

Full training is provided. If you enjoy helping people and taking responsibility, we can support the rest.
Every Solus site is different, but our expectations are consistent. Customer Consultants are trusted to juggle customer service, vehicle movements and site support with professionalism and care.
At Solus, you'll find:
- A supportive team environment where collaboration matters
- Clear processes, alongside the flexibility to use judgement day to day
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career over time
- An inclusive culture where reliability and kindness are valued

Solus, who are owned by Aviva, are one of the UK leaders in vehicle repairs, returning cars to the road in just 11 days on average and a 4.6/5 star customer rating. With an award-winning apprenticeship programme and winners of other recognised industry awards Solus are proud to be shaping the future of vehicle repair.
Why Join Solus?
We have so much to offer when it comes to being a Solus colleague:
- Competitive salary based on location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
- Bonus opportunity tied to your performance and the overall success of Solus.
- Company pension scheme with employer contributions.
- 33 days' holiday (including bank holidays), with the option to buy or sell up to 5 days.
- Save money with up to 40% discount on Aviva products and other retailer discounts.
- Share in Aviva's success through the Aviva Save As You Earn scheme.
- Supportive policies including parental and carer's leave.
- Wellbeing focus with tools like Group Income Protection and 24/7 GP access.

At Solus, we value inclusivity and welcome all applicants. If you're excited but don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply-your unique skills might be just what we need.
We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants meeting the minimum criteria-just email us after applying to let us know.
Ready to join us? Apply online today, and our team will be in touch within 14 days.

title: Customer Service & Account Coordinator
description:
I'm recruiting for an established business seeking a highly capable Customer Service & Account Coordinator to join its technical services team.

This is a varied position combining customer service, account coordination and detailed administration. You'll support a portfolio of important clients, helping to coordinate the analysis and classification of materials generated through construction and site-based projects.

You don't necessarily need previous experience within this industry, as the technical knowledge can be taught. What matters most is that you're organised, accurate and confident dealing with customers, with the administrative ability to keep multiple requests moving smoothly.

The role

You'll take ownership of client requests from the initial enquiry through to the delivery of results and supporting documentation. Acting as a central link between customers, laboratories and colleagues across the business, you'll ensure information is accurate, deadlines are understood and clients are kept informed throughout.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Building strong working relationships with key customers and acting as their main day-to-day contact
- Responding professionally to enquiries by telephone and email
- Understanding the individual requirements of different accounts and ensuring the appropriate service is delivered
- Keeping customers updated on progress, results, outstanding information and any issues affecting delivery
- Coordinating the testing and classification of soil, asphalt and other waste materials
- Receiving and reviewing sample and testing requests, ensuring all necessary information is captured accurately
- Working with external laboratories and internal technical teams to arrange the appropriate testing
- Monitoring samples and testing requirements from receipt through to completion
- Ensuring customers receive the correct results, reports and classification documentation
- Following up on outstanding samples, information, approvals and test results
- Entering and maintaining accurate customer, project, sample and testing information on internal systems
- Preparing and processing quotations, orders, requests and supporting account documentation
- Assisting with invoicing and other administrative activities when required
- Investigating discrepancies, identifying missing information and seeing issues through to resolution
- Coordinating with technical, laboratory, operational and administrative colleagues to communicate priorities and meet deadlines
- Escalating technical, operational or customer-service issues when appropriate
- Developing your understanding of relevant testing methods and maintaining up-to-date industry knowledge
- Contributing ideas to improve internal processes and the overall customer experience

About you

This opportunity is likely to suit someone who:
- Has strong customer service and administrative skills
- Is highly organised and able to manage several priorities simultaneously
- Takes pride in accuracy and has excellent attention to detail
- Is confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- Works carefully and methodically when handling information and entering data
- Is proactive, dependable and comfortable working independently
- Is confident using IT systems and able to learn new software
- Approaches problems practically and follows them through to a resolution
- Is keen to learn and comfortable developing knowledge of a technical subject

Previous experience

Previous experience in customer service, account coordination or a detailed administrative position would be advantageous.

Exposure to construction, utilities, environmental services, materials testing, waste classification, laboratory services or technical administration would also be useful, as would experience using CRM, laboratory management or similar business systems.

However, industry knowledge is desirable rather than essential. The employer is equally open to someone from another sector who can demonstrate excellent customer service, first-rate organisation and a genuine willingness to learn.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys looking after customers, coordinating detailed processes and making sure nothing is overlooked.

title: Operations Business Support Coordinator

Contract: Permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid, with Mondays and Fridays working from home

The Opportunity
